settings.heading: How to use
settings.content: Shake well. Hold 8–10 inches from skin and mist evenly with the 360° nozzle. Build in light layers to your preferred depth of bronze. Wear alone, over makeup, or as a setting spray.

settings.heading: Ingredients
settings.content: Paraben, sulfate and phthalate free. Low in DHA, non-comedogenic, 100% vegan and never tested on animals.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: We ship internationally. Shipping is calculated at checkout.
